unit.why: A brief report that the Yeshuot Yaakov's study room in Lviv bore an inscription quoting the Yerushalmi that no one today knows how to judge a Torah case. It belongs to the surrounding halakhic-homiletic discussion of judging, and nothing happens to anyone.
unit.boundary_note: continues the previous division's discussion of litigants and din torah; the trailing 'מענין דיקדוק התיבות' looks like the heading of a new section that runs into the next division
